title: Ronies Droney Tomato Macaroni and Cheese

items: ½ lb American cheese, torn into about 1-inch pieces
1 to 1½ cups milk or half-and-half (enough to just cover the cheese)

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. Cook the macaroni until al dente, following the package time (usually 6 to 8 min), until tender but still firm to the bite. Drain in a colander and set aside.
Put the butter in the bottom of a 3-quart saucepan, then spread the torn cheese over it in an even layer.
Pour in enough milk or half-and-half to just cover the cheese. Season with salt and pepper.
Set the pan over low heat. Stir every few min until the cheese is fully melted and the sauce is smooth, 8 to 12 min. Keep the heat low so the sauce doesn't boil or turn grainy.
Stir in the condensed tomato soup straight from the can. Keep stirring over low heat until the sauce is an even orange color and hot, 2 to 3 min.
Add the drained macaroni and stir to coat. Let it warm through over low heat, stirring now and then, 2 to 3 min. Taste, add more salt and pepper if needed, and serve hot.
tips: To feed a crowd, double or triple everything and use a larger pot.
Half-and-half makes a richer, creamier sauce than milk.
Any short pasta works in place of elbows, like shells or rotini.
storage: Refrigerate in a covered container for up to 3 days. Reheat on the stove over low heat or in the microwave, stirring in a splash of milk to loosen the sauce. It doesn't freeze well because the sauce turns grainy.
